label: 01 Onboarding
caption: 01 · Onboarding
note: Enhanced: abstract slide art replaced with a live marketplace preview — a real voice note, a request and a Jeeber offer float around the mic; AR headline pairs the EN copy; Skip and Next share one row.

label: 02 Registration
caption: 02 · Registration
note: Enhanced: phone-first — the field and Send code lead (the app's only working auth), social demoted to compact secondary pills; brand hero folds the welcome + bilingual tagline into one navy band; live-valid check on the field; trust footer replaces fine print.

label: 03 OTP verify
caption: 03 · OTP verify
note: Enhanced: in-screen keypad (no OS keyboard covering the code), active cell with live caret in orange, auto-verify on the 4th digit, inline Edit-number instead of a buried text button, resend timer kept in view.

label: 04 Client home
caption: 04 · Client home
note: Enhanced: the buried "+" becomes a mic-first create hero ("hold to talk"); voice requests show their waveform on the card; broadcasting state shows live reach (12 Jeebers); replies show the offer floor ($8) with Jeeber avatars and a direct View offers action; chips carry counts.

label: 05 Voice recording
caption: 05 · Voice recording
note: Enhanced: one-handed layout — the hold-to-record mic sits in the bottom thumb zone with slide-to-cancel (left) and switch-to-typing (right) in reach; live transcript reads at the top while you speak; max-duration ring shows the time budget.

label: 06 Transcription review
caption: 06 · Transcription review
note: Enhanced: low-confidence words get a tappable orange underline (fix one word, not the whole text), detected language surfaced as a chip, quick-add chips for quantity/brand/budget, replay card with scrubber kept above the text.

label: 07 Request type
caption: 07 · Request type
note: Enhanced: the 5-tier spectrum reads as one scannable list — selected tier snaps to solid navy with an orange check, "Most picked" nudge on Standard, speed + price value on every row, and the delivery location is confirmed on the same step with a one-tap Change.

label: 08 Tier catalog
caption: 08 · Tier catalog
note: Enhanced: honest price signal — a relative price-level meter per tier (urgent = pays more, relaxed = pays less) instead of unpredictable dollar figures; SLA chip and vehicle class on every card, Recommended pre-selected, and a note making clear Jeebers set the price via offers.

label: 09 Location picker
caption: 09 · Location picker
note: Enhanced: map-first with a draggable pin (the shipped picker is a form with the map behind a button), pickup→drop-off progress as chips, GPS accuracy stated on the address card, saved places (Home/Work/Mama's) one tap away.

label: 10 Request summary
caption: 10 · Request summary
note: Enhanced: six loose cards become one request ticket — voice replay on top, transcript with inline Edit, tier / route / photos as rows each with its own Change link, route drawn as a pickup→drop-off timeline, and the CTA renamed to what actually happens: Broadcast. Typed request? The audio bar simply isn't rendered — the ticket leads with the text: TYPED REQUEST Edit Panadol Extra, one box — from the pharmacy next to my building ⚡ Flash…rest of the ticket identical

label: 11 Offers
caption: 11 · Offers
note: Enhanced: Best-value pick surfaced with a badge (price × rating × distance), "Fastest" tagged so speed shoppers see it instantly, offer-window countdown with progress bar, review count next to stars, and the cash-on-delivery amount spelled out per card before accepting.

label: 12 Live tracking
caption: 12 · Live tracking
note: Enhanced: order context pinned up top (what + tier + cash due), the 4-step stepper with a pulsing live step, ETA chip on the map, the door code always visible from accept time (the shipped app could hide it), and no-show / dispute recovery actions kept one tap away.

label: 13 OTP handover
caption: 13 · OTP handover
note: Enhanced: at-door moment made unmissable — orange arrival banner with cash due, the 4 digits as giant navy tiles readable at arm's length (screen auto-brightens), "say it or show it" instruction, safety copy ("never by phone"), SMS fallback and dispute exit both honest and visible.

label: 14 Receipt confirm
caption: 14 · Receipt confirm
note: Enhanced: the Jeeber's proof photo leads with timestamp + zoom, the cash line is a single navy statement ("Pay $8 cash to Karim — no card, no fees"), and the fork is plain-spoken: "Yes, I got it" vs "Not yet — something's wrong" (→ dispute). Deliberately no commission line — platform economics never show on customer surfaces.

label: 15 Mutual rating
caption: 15 · Mutual rating
note: Enhanced: the blind two-way mechanic is explained in one line (ratings reveal together), delivery context recapped under the avatar (what · time · price), star labels ("Great") confirm the tap, and the tag taxonomy matches the gateway's five. Mandatory by design — no skip, no back.

label: 16 Jeeber home
caption: 16 · Jeeber home
note: Enhanced: the auto-offline timer is visible on the availability card ("goes offline in 1h 40m" + Extend) instead of silently kicking Jeebers offline, the just-won delivery is pinned above the feed with cash due, feed cards lead with distance + neighbourhood, and voice requests keep their waveform mark.

label: 17 Offer composer
caption: 17 · Offer composer
note: Enhanced: the money math is the hero — offer → 10% fee → "you keep $7.20" computed live and repeated on the CTA; ETA is picked from the tier's allowed band (no free-typing an impossible time); ±$1 steppers for fast pricing; wallet balance + top-up inline so a 402 never surprises.

label: 18 Active delivery Jeeber
caption: 18 · Active delivery — Jeeber
note: Enhanced: the at-door moment is one orange panel — proof photo ✓, optional note, door-code entry and the complete CTA together (the shipped app scatters them); the drop-off card states what to collect ($8 fee + $6.50 goods); Maps / Chat / goods-Costs quick actions pinned in the thumb zone.

label: 19 Earnings
caption: 19 · Earnings
note: Enhanced: one navy hero card answers "how did I do" (cash collected + deliveries + avg kept + rating) instead of four equal grey cards; "never through Jeeb" trust line kept; per-delivery rows show tier, cash in and fee out together; wallet balance and PDF export pinned at the bottom.

label: 20 Settings
caption: 20 · Settings
note: Enhanced: profile promoted to a navy identity card, "Become a Jeeber" surfaced as the one growth action (orange outline), EN/عربي as a live segmented toggle, notification toggles grouped in one outlined card with door-codes honestly marked always-on, destructive actions demoted to the bottom.

label: 21 Order chat
caption: 21 · Order chat

Arabic; mic kept primary in the composer.

caption: 22 · Become a Jeeber

label: 23 Wallet
caption: 23 · Wallet

caption: 24 · Order history
